## Background

We ran 3 AlphaFold2 predictions,

- HIV-PR_monomer
- HIV-PR_dimer
- My find-a-gene protein sequence

Here we analyze the resulting models and make some diagnostic plots that inform on model realibility

## HIV-PR_monomer

### Read the AF models 

```{r}
list.files(path="HIVMonomer_94b4b",
           full.names=F, 
           pattern=".pdb")
```

```{r}
pdb_files <- list.files(path="HIVMonomer_94b5b", 
                        full.names=T,
                        pattern=".pdb")
```

```{r}
library(bio3d)

pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit=TRUE, exefile="msa")
```

### RMSD

Calculate the RMSD of all models to each other (i.e pairwise RMSD)

```{r}
rd <- rmsd(pdbs, fit=T)
```

Draw a heatmap of these RMSD matrix values

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
pheatmap(rd)
```

### RMSF 

Calculate RMSF- how far apart each amino acid is across all 5 Alphafold models

```{r}
rf <- rmsf(pdbs$xyz)

plotb3(rf, sse=pdbs)
abline(v=100, col="gray", ylab="RMSF")
```

### Residue Conservation 

Read the AF MSA 

```{r}
aln_file <- list.files(path="HIVMonomer_94b5b",
                       pattern=".a3m$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
#aln_file

aln <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper = TRUE)
```

We can score residue conservation in the alignment with the `conserv()` function.

```{r}
sim <- conserv(aln)
```

Plot this result 

```{r}
plotb3(sim, type="h")
```

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.88)
con$seq
```

For a final visualization of these functionally important sites we can map this conservation score to the Occupancy column of a PDB file for viewing in molecular viewer programs such as Mol*, PyMol, VMD, chimera etc.

```{r}
m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])
occ <- vec2resno(sim[1:99], m1.pdb$atom$resno)
write.pdb(m1.pdb, o=occ, file="m1_conserv.pdb")
```

### AF scores (pLDDT & PAE score plots)

The pLDDT scores are stored in the PDB models "B-factor" col and in a seperate JSON format file in the results directory. We can use either: 

```{r}
plotb3(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2)
points(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")
abline(v=100, col="gray")

#plot(m1.pdb$atom$b[m1.pdb$calalpha], type="h")
```

## HIV-PR Dimer

### Read the AF models 

```{r}
list.files(path="HIVDimer_23119_0",
           full.names=F, 
           pattern=".pdb")
```

```{r}
pdb_files <- list.files(path="HIVDimer_23119_0", 
                        full.names=T,
                        pattern=".pdb")
```

```{r}
library(bio3d)

pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit=TRUE, exefile="msa")
```

### RMSD

Calculate the RMSD of all models to each other (i.e pairwise RMSD)

```{r}
rd <- rmsd(pdbs, fit=T)
```

Add a heatmap of these RMSD matrix values

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
```

\`\`\`

### RMSF

Calculate RMSF- how far apart each amino acid is across all 5 Alphafold models

```{r}
rf <- rmsf(pdbs$xyz)

plotb3(rf, sse=pdbs)
abline(v=100, col="gray", ylab="RMSF")
```


### Residue Conservation

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.88)
con$seq
```
For a final visualization of these functionally important sites we can map this conservation score to the Occupancy column of a PDB file for viewing in molecular viewer programs such as Mol*, PyMol, VMD, chimera etc.

```{r}
# Read the HIV protease dimer
pdb_files <- list.files("HIVDimer_23119_0",
                        pattern = "\\.pdb$",
                        recursive = TRUE,
                        full.names = TRUE)

m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])

# Load the HIV alignment
aln_file <- list.files("HIVMonomer_94b5b",
                       pattern = "\\.a3m$",
                       full.names = TRUE)

aln_hiv <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper = TRUE)
hiv_sim <- conserv(aln_hiv)

# Remove gaps and get 99 conservation scores
keep <- !aln_hiv$ali[1, ] %in% c("-", ".")
hiv_sim_99 <- hiv_sim[keep]

# Assign scores to both chains
occ <- hiv_sim_99[m1.pdb$atom$resno]

# Save the PDB
write.pdb(m1.pdb, o = occ, file = "m1_conserv.pdb")

```


### AF Scores (pLDDT & PAE score plots)

The pLDDT scores are stored in the PDB models "B-factor" col and in a separate JSON format file in the results directory. We can use either: 

```{r}
plotb3(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2)
points(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")

```

## Find a gene project

### Read the AF models

```{r}
list.files(path="find_a_gene_f85f6",
           full.names=F, 
           pattern=".pdb")
```

```{r}
pdb_files <- list.files(path="find_a_gene_f85f6", 
                        full.names=T,
                        pattern=".pdb")
```

```{r}
library(bio3d)

pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit=TRUE, exefile="msa")
```

### RMSD

Calculate the RMSD of all models to each other (i.e pairwise RMSD)

```{r}
rd <- rmsd(pdbs, fit=T)
```

Add a heatmap of these RMSD matrix values: 

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
pheatmap(rd)
```


### RMSF

Calculate RMSF- how far apart each amino acid is across all 5 Alphafold models

```{r}
rf <- rmsf(pdbs$xyz)

plotb3(rf, sse=pdbs)
abline(v=100, col="gray", ylab="RMSF")
```


### Residue Conservation

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.88)
con$seq
```

For a final visualization of these functionally important sites we can map this conservation score to the Occupancy column of a PDB file for viewing in molecular viewer programs such as Mol*, PyMol, VMD, chimera etc.

```{r}
# Read the Find a Gene protein
pdb_files <- list.files("find_a_gene_f85f6",
                        pattern = "\\.pdb$",
                        recursive = TRUE,
                        full.names = TRUE)

m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])

# Calculate conservation scores
aln <- read.fasta("aln.fa")
sim <- conserv(aln)

aln_file <- list.files("HIVMonomer_94b5b",
                       pattern = "\\.a3m$",
                       full.names = TRUE)

aln_hiv <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper = TRUE)
hiv_sim <- conserv(aln_hiv)

# Remove alignment gaps
keep <- !aln$ali[1, ] %in% c("-", ".")
sim_gene <- sim[keep]

# Assign scores to the protein
occ <- sim_gene[m1.pdb$atom$resno]

# Check for missing scores
stopifnot(!anyNA(occ))

# Save the PDB
write.pdb(m1.pdb, o = occ, file = "gene_conserv.pdb")
```

The pLDDT scores are stored in the PDB models "B-factor" col and in a seperate JSON format file in the results directory. We can use either:

```{r}
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
```
